# 1 Clement Chapter 63 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 63 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_063_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 63

**63:1** Therefore it is right that we should be attentive to so great and so many examples and submit the neck — that is, to practice obedience — so that ceasing from the futile sedition we may attain, without any blame, to the goal set before us in truth.

**63:2** For you will give us joy and gladness if you are obedient to what we have written through the Holy Spirit, and root out the unlawful anger of your jealousy, according to the entreaty for peace and harmony which we have penned in this letter.

**63:3** We have also sent to you faithful and prudent men who have lived virtuously among us from youth to old age, and they will be witnesses between you and us.

**63:4** This we have done that you may know that our whole concern has been and is that you should quickly attain peace.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
